parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO error_logs (
  error_id, timestamp, severity, workflow_name, workflow_id, 
  execution_id, node_name, node_type, error_message, error_stack, 
  error_type, environment, execution_time_ms, retry_count, user_id, 
  tags, custom_data
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.errorId }}',
  '{{ $json.timestamp }}',
  '{{ $json.severity }}',
  '{{ $json.workflow.name }}',
  '{{ $json.workflow.id }}',
  '{{ $json.workflow.executionId }}',
  '{{ $json.node.name }}',
  '{{ $json.node.type }}',
  '{{ $json.error.message }}',
  '{{ $json.error.stack }}',
  '{{ $json.error.type }}',
  '{{ $json.context.environment }}',
  {{ $json.context.executionTime || 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.context.retryCount }},
  {{ $json.metadata.userId ? `'${$json.metadata.userId}'` : 'NULL' }},
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.metadata.tags) }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.metadata.customData) }}'
)

-- Cleanup old error logs (retention: 90 days)
DELETE FROM error_logs 
WHERE timestamp < NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days';

-- Return cleanup stats
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_errors,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN severity = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 END) as critical_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN severity = 'WARNING' THEN 1 END) as warning_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN severity = 'INFO' THEN 1 END) as info_count,
  MIN(timestamp) as oldest_log,
  MAX(timestamp) as newest_log
FROM error_logs;
